name: cu_observe
description: Observe bounded native Accessibility JSON, Set native_only=true to prohibit screenshot/OCR fallback; the existing automatic local OCR behavior remains the default. Use background and since to reduce interruption and repeated context. Set draft_values=true only for a requested send review to read bounded exact nonsecure composer fields; incomplete reads are explicit, and default editable values remain omitted.

name: cu_act
description: Act on a snapshot-scoped cu element. Set background for AX-only execution with no focus, screenshots, or pointer fallback. Use native_only=true for semantic verification without capture; unchanged results remain indeterminate.

name: cu_audit
description: Audit a native Accessibility tree without screenshots: unnamed interactive controls, duplicate accessible names, and generic-element counts.

name: cu_wait
description: Wait for a window, semantic element/value, stability, or visual change.

name: cu_batch
description: Run a guarded line-oriented cu action batch in one process.

name: cu_shot
description: Capture a full screen or named app window to a local PNG.

name: cu_click
description: Click logical macOS screen coordinates. Supply app to refuse clicks unless that app is frontmost; set window_relative when coordinates came from a window capture.

name: cu_clickel
description: Click a native Accessibility element by app and accessible name, with role/index disambiguation.

name: cu_type
description: Type text into the focused field; use paced for fragile Simulator/custom fields.

name: cu_read
description: Read the current Safari/Chromium document using native Accessibility. No screenshot, OCR, focus change or page JavaScript. Returns bounded text, verified URL and explicit partial coverage. Read-only; use observe for actionable handles. Optional url selects a unique visible browser document by origin/path across that app’s windows, without focus changes. Query strings and fragments do not distinguish documents; duplicate matches fail safely. Use this to retain a known page when a profile picker or another window is in front.

name: cu_select_file
description: Select a represented local regular file through a verified native macOS Open panel. Bind the observed PID/window and provide captured expected_source metadata to reject source replacements before selection. English native panels only. No screenshots or arbitrary keyboard commands. Dispatch is not upload/send/delivery proof; inspect the prepared attachment and obtain required send approval separately. Never replay an uncertain result.
